integrity: Theorem and proof are self-contained. The accompanying deterministic quadrature code reproduces numerical values but cannot independently certify the asymptotic statement.
scientific_limitations: Fixed cone ratio \(0<\alpha<1\) only; intrinsic pair-distance near the diameter; not an all-radius CDF or a uniform estimate near the round-sphere endpoint. Historical priority and independent mathematical validation are not established.
title: The diameter-tail coefficient recovers the cone angle of spherical footballs
